campaign.title: Hard-M1 high-squarefree-radical signed cone gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: No numerical theorem evidence is planned. Exact finite checks may only falsify product grouping, squarefree support, or controls and cannot certify the asymptotic target.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete literal high-squarefree-radical part of every residual hard-M1 product cone be bounded by L^(3/2) X^epsilon, closing the hard direct-M1 parent after the low-radical sector is paid, or does the first genuinely new actual-direction contraction self-return or retain L^2 capacity?
frozen_target.reference_formula: |sum_(s>L, mu^2(s)=1) sum_(t>=1) C_(L,X)(s t^2) e(t sqrt(Xs))| <<_epsilon L^(3/2) X^epsilon, where C_(L,X)(r)=sum_(h|r, h asymp L, r/h odd, 4h<r/h<16h) chi_4(r/h) a_(L,X)^lit(h,r/h).
quantities: The exact hard cone is T_L^M1=sum_(h asymp L)sum_(4h<n<16h,n odd)chi_4(n)a_(L,X)^lit(h,n)e(sqrt(Xhn)).

The symbol retains Phi(h/(H+1)), W(sqrt(4q_X h/n)), normalized powers, the dyadic shell, strict cone edges, floors, stars, both frequency signs, hard sample, real-X support crossings, and zero extensions.
Write every product uniquely as r=s t^2 with mu^2(s)=1; literal support gives s<<L^2 and t<<L/sqrt(s).
The proposed low-radical sector s<=L is target-safe by O(1+L/sqrt(s)) square multipliers and divisor-incidence multiplicity.
High-radical coefficient-insensitive capacity is L^2 X^epsilon against target L^(3/2) X^epsilon, leaving L^(1/2)=X^(1/12) at L asymp X^(1/6).
The t=1 high-radical face is mandatory; no gain may come only from averaging square multipliers.
BAL, UNBAL, smooth M1, GAR, M2, assembly, bridges, and exponent claims are forbidden pivots.

completion_criteria: Derive the exact product-fibre identity, unique squarefree decomposition, support ranges, and low-radical incidence bound with every literal seam.
Attack the complete high-radical aggregate before any positive norm, retaining the actual chi_4-weighted coefficient and t=1 face.
Price every proposed fixed-t, joint-t, TT*, trace, completion, or spectral step against the exact missing L^(1/2).
Run perfect-square-centre, t=1, dechirped, arbitrary-coefficient, character-erased, endpoint, one-site, one-fibre, and hard-boundary controls.
Verify the exact implication from the high-radical target plus low-radical bound to M9-M1-top-endpoint-signed-cone only.
Prove the complete target, prove a strict owner-compatible target-safe sector with its exact complement, or establish the first exact capacity or self-return obstruction of a genuinely new mechanism.
Do not repeat product-fibre triangle, rank-one square-root wave, singular Hessian, second B-process, adjacent odd pairing, profile subtraction, canonical Gram, or combined M1/M2 routes.
Close under exactly one authorized exit label after blind and seam review.

required_output: A seven-section hostile audit satisfying the repository report contract.

tasks.target: From the isolated finite packet, derive the squarefree split, low-sector incidence bound, high-sector capacity and false controls, and the first structural relation required for the proposed fixed-direction saving.

review_seams.requirement: Verify exact product regrouping, squarefree uniqueness, support, multiplicity, low-radical power, and all hard-profile endpoints.
Verify that every claimed saving retains the literal coefficient, chi_4, t=1, and exact L^(1/2) ledger before positivity.
Compare the isolated finite analysis with the literal hard coefficient without contaminating blind provenance or treating capacity as literal lower mass.
Verify the exact implication to the hard direct-M1 parent only and quarantine smooth M1, GAR, M9-M1, M9-M2, bridges, theorem, and exponent claims.

closing_assessment.main_result: Exact product and squarefree coordinates, the low-radical sector, and the disjoint high-radical large-multiplier sector are proved at target size. The exact small-t complement, including t=1, remains open. Complete Mobius linearization self-returns to the original cone modulo a target-safe correction; joint-t and central-Mellin automatic closures are parked only in their proved scopes.
